current_foundation: entity_relationships stores provider-neutral cross-entity relationships with provenance, verification_state and metadata JSON
relationship vocabulary already includes performed_by, written_by, has_member/member_of and recording_of
artist_recording retains credited_name/join_phrase as an older specialized representation
relationship-credit-read-semantics.gap: Public/application code lacks one explicit provider-neutral credit/relationship projection contract covering role/type, credited display text, ordering/join phrase where present, provenance and verification.
relationship-credit-read-semantics.rule: entity_relationships is the durable generic relationship authority; do not create a second credits table solely for Stage 20.

current_foundation: provider_destinations already associates provider resources with canonical entities
destination records include review/verification evidence and provider-specific media state
external identifiers and destinations never replace SongChart canonical identity
destination-media-read-semantics.gap: Application/public detail composition lacks one explicit destination projection contract defining approved-only visibility, mutable embeddability/availability and provider-neutral output shape.

current_foundation: entity_relationships indexes subject identity and object identity separately
public projections must filter relationship verification state
relationship-public-query-index.gap: The durable relationship store has no composite verified-read index aligned with subject/object public projection access patterns.
relationship-public-query-index.migration_change: Add composite subject/object + verification_state + relationship_type indexes without changing historical migrations.

current_foundation: account overview/profile/security routes and controllers exist
account-use-case-registry-drift.gap: Account route surfaces are not represented in the executable use-case registry.
account-use-case-registry-drift.rule: Register existing account reads without inventing follow/social/recommendation persistence.

current_foundation: domain-contracts.json contains release_group and expanded relationship vocabulary
migrations/models implement release groups and provider destinations
domain-model-human-companion-drift.gap: DOMAIN_MODEL.md is behind the machine authority and can mislead humans/AI into proposing duplicate entities.

current_foundation: canonical collections and collection_items already exist
collection-ownership.gap: No accepted Stage 20 journey requires member-owned collections or social collection behavior.
collection-ownership.rule: Defer ownership/social semantics until a product journey explicitly accepts them.
